findings.note: Game preview: Spoelstra moved Wiggins to the bench and started Pelle Larsson instead, and in his first game off the bench Wiggins scored 6 points on 2-of-6 shooting in 32 minutes. Utah is injury-depleted and has lost eight straight, which could help the Over.

In the Oct. 21 season opener, Wiggins started and scored 11 points on 5-of-11 shooting in 27 minutes while all five Heat starters reached double figures. That suggests he gets fewer shots next to Giannis Antetokounmpo than he did last season, when he averaged 15.4 points.
The Jazz's official preview lists Giannis as probable with a right wrist sprain and says injuries have thinned Utah's frontcourt rotation. That points to a soft interior matchup for him.

On Nov 9, Giannis was listed as probable for Utah with a right wrist sprain. He has been on recent injury reports but has not missed a game, and he scored 29 against Sacramento and 30 earlier in the week.
ESPN's game page shows Giannis averaging 27.5 points this season, below the 28.5 line, with 62.2% free-throw shooting. It also lists him as day-to-day with a wrist injury.
